title: Climax Community
definition: The final, stable, and self-perpetuating stage of ecological succession in an ecosystem, where the community composition remains relatively constant until disturbed by external environmental factors.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding ecosystem stability, biodiversity conservation, and forest management policies; frequently tested in the context of ecological succession and biome resilience.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Climax Community.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
